stem: Which sentence from the selection best explains why the health of coral reefs is of great concern to scientists?

options.label: A
options.text: Coral reefs are home to one-fourth of all marine life on the planet and serve as a natural barrier against damage caused by storms, hurricanes, and typhoons.

options.label: B
options.text: These reefs can be damaged by natural disasters such as hurricanes, or they can be affected by human-related activities such as large ships running their hulls along a reef or fishing equipment scraping the sea floor.

options.label: C
options.text: Scientists at CMBB hope to program Coralbots to locate colonies of endangered coral and reconstruct them.

options.label: D
options.text: Scientists and volunteer divers work to reassemble damaged coral, but their success has been minimal.
